description: Defines a template class CalculatorVector for managing a vector of generic type TType, providing methods for element access, modification, insertion, removal, and string representation.

classes.name: CalculatorVector
classes.description: A template class providing vector management functionalities with error handling and string conversion.

methods.name: GetAt
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index, returns E_BOUNDS if out of range.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the vector.

methods.name: SetAt
methods.description: Sets the element at the specified index, returns E_BOUNDS if out of range.

methods.name: RemoveAt
methods.description: Removes the element at the specified index, returns E_BOUNDS if out of range.

methods.name: InsertAt
methods.description: Inserts an element at the specified index, returns E_OUTOFMEMORY on allocation failure.

methods.name: Truncate
methods.description: Truncates the vector at the specified index, returns E_BOUNDS if out of range.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends an element to the end of the vector, returns E_OUTOFMEMORY on failure.

methods.name: RemoveAtEnd
methods.description: Removes the last element from the vector.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the vector.

methods.name: GetString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the vector contents.

methods.name: GetExpressionSuffix
methods.description: Returns a suffix string for the expression, default is ' ='
